purpose: Teach: 人様/見合っ/ヶ国/すぐさま/助長/覆っ/ほかなら/乗せる

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、人様の物を触っちゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you mustn't touch other people's things.
lines.style: Gentle but firm correction. Light maternal authority—no anger, just a boundary being set. Clear and steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと目が合って見合って笑っちゃったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I made eye contact and both just... laughed.
lines.style: Bright, almost amazed at the smallness of it. Eager to share. A little searching—like he wants her to understand why it mattered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが海外二十ヶ国を回られたんだって
lines.en: Your father visited twenty countries overseas, did you know that?
lines.style: Warm, slightly proud recollection. Conversational—mentioning something she's just remembered or learned about him. Soft and reflective.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがすぐさま助けて下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad helped me right away.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude underneath. Not bragging—reporting something small that felt significant. Soft finish, like he's still processing the kindness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、悪い習慣を助長しないよう気を付けようね
lines.en: Sho, let's be careful not to encourage bad habits, all right?
lines.style: Thoughtful guidance, not scolding. Speaking to him as someone capable of understanding. Steady maternal tone, a touch of wistfulness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お部屋の床がカーペットで覆ってあるよ
lines.en: Mom, the floor in the room is covered with carpet.
lines.style: Observant and matter-of-fact. A six-year-old noticing details. Slight eagerness—showing her something he's just found interesting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはほかならぬ家族の支えね
lines.en: Your father is our family's greatest support, Sho.
lines.style: Tender certainty. Speaking a quiet truth she wants him to know and remember. Warm, grounded, no performance—just love being stated plainly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに肩車に乗せるって言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said he'd give me a piggyback ride.
lines.style: Barely contained joy. Breathless with anticipation. The eagerness of a child about to get exactly what he wants. Guileless.
